sameDayRetelling: Sable Ash, the third heir, went down with my boss-focus card and a fire potion I'd swapped in, and for the first time the Bloat Mother died to fire instead of driving him home. He kept going through the Crypt, killed the Lich at D18 and pushed into the Foundry, banking $6441 and setting the D19 record. One run later he reached D23 and then, while I was away, slew the Foundry Master and died to an iron golem with $1710 on him.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Numbers everywhere and mostly legible (Carried/Secured, FLOOR CHANCE per depth), but the death sheet said "forecast said D13 100%" on a death, 'compare outcomes' only ever said "all similar", the custom-rules lock text turned into "Upcoming reports", and '5/4 · drop one' appeared without my action.

Real trade-offs with shown consequence: one heal potion moved "D7 50% -> 100%", boss focus L4 took "floor 14 13% -> 38%"; but forge/upgrades were strictly ordered and the apprentice auto-spent $10k, and style comparisons returned "all similar".

Learned that unknown potions are never drunk ("drink heal at 35% unknown item") and that bosses name counters ("COUNTER: THROW FIRE, BOSS"); after D23 nothing new to learn surfaced in 8h away ("Goal D24" unchanged).

Carried gold is a real stake: "banked $448 ... 3/36 hp" vs "$1710 lost"; but I chose the stakes only indirectly (rules were drilled), and three D23/D18 deaths in a row at 1 hp felt like the same coin flip.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: "Ulusk the goblin is avenged.", captives, "A shrine. Pray, at a price.", four lanes (Burrows/Fens/Crypt/Foundry); by the 8h return deaths repeated at D18 ghoul and D23 skeleton/golem.
My configuration was Steady + boss focus + heir trait + forged kit; the one rule I wrote ("hp < 50% → attack pack") had to be dropped at "5/4 · drop one". Little of the build felt mine.
Reel lines carry a turn: "Slag crawlers cornered him to 3 HP; attacked; died to golem.", plus grudges ("grudge: Vrul the iron golem") and a 7-heir bloodline; repetitive by the end.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace

Weight 0. Named heirs and grudges only.
I chose supplies (swapped a leash for "fire potion") and tactic cards; route stayed "D5 burrows" and goals were set by the game ("Goal D24 · New record").

Within-run D4 -> D23 over the cold hour; persistent forge ("sword +1" -> "sword +4", mail), Legacy ranks; automation cadence strong (porter, scout, apprentice, keeper, drillmaster each 'no longer need to'). Lapse: 4h+8h away added no new depth (best D23 throughout).

Visual only: the town grows from "Empty town" to lit cottages, a campfire and walking workers; the torn red death banner is striking; dungeon lighting by lane. Lapse: summary chips overlap the boss bar/HUD in the watch view. Audio unassessed.
